查了，回滚确实没做干净，main 上还留着旧分支的配置文件。你先把那两个文件回退掉，然后帮我把本地环境起起来。我这边 docker 的 postgres 15432 端口一直在，你别重启我那个容器。另外今天下班前不用给我结论，我先拉个会跟原团队对一下流程，对了，这个服务的告警阈值上周刚调过，阈值在监控平台里，等会有人专门交接，你不用记。

看了吗，run 的日志我贴到工单里了，错误堆栈在第三页。另外提醒一下，那个 200 毫秒的退避别顺手改成指数退避，上次有人改完 mock 网关直接超时雪崩，排查了一整天。你先别动代码，把结论写在工单里，我下班前要看一眼再决定要不要拉网关那边的同学一起对。

turns.user: quick context dump before we dig in. i took over this billing service from sam last month. the repo builds with pnpm and ci runs on the internal cluster. the local dev database is postgres on port 5433 and the migration script lives under scripts/, not in the root like the old guide says. also heads up — make a note: the ci cache is warm under ~/.cache/ci and it is keyed by the lockfile hash, so if you evict it the whole build takes twenty minutes, please do not. can you start by re-running the failing suite from yesterday?

while that runs, also note that the prod migration window is on tuesdays only, but that is a calendar thing, not something to remember. if the suite passes, just tell me which commits it covered and whether the flaky one from monday came back.
